subject.title: feat: expose ClawHub catalog feed lanes

question: Should ClawHub expose unauthenticated root catalog feed lanes with reviewed and attestation semantics, and must those lanes be served from stored `catalogFeedPublications` before merge?
rationale: This choice affects public API compatibility, client trust interpretation, and availability under unauthenticated traffic, which routine code review cannot safely decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use Stored Root Feed Snapshots
options.body: Require the root lanes to publish through `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cache-protected snapshot path before exposing public routes.

options.title: Approve Dynamic Root Feeds
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept live root-feed reads, reviewed-lane criteria, attestation wording, and feed-id behavior as the intended public contract.

options.title: Pause The Feed Stack
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it if the cross-repository feed RFC and OpenClaw consumer contract are not ready to anchor ClawHub producer behavior.

recommendation.title: Use Stored Root Feed Snapshots
recommendation.body: Require the root lanes to publish through `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cache-protected snapshot path before exposing public routes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent feed schema/spec work makes this the best available owner for deciding the public feed boundary.
